assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent shortness of breath consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
To better characterize the frequency and duration of these arrhythmic events and guide long-term management, a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
The claim is for CPT code 93247
The service represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
The appeal addresses the denial under Reason Code PR-204
